name: HyperFrames Creative Direction
summary: Shape the visual identity, storyboard, narration and composition plan for a HyperFrames video.
problem: Video builds become inconsistent when palette, typography, narration and beat planning are decided independently during implementation.
coreOutcomes: Translate the brief into a coherent visual system
Plan narrative beats and scene composition
Record design decisions in reusable project specifications
requirements: A HyperFrames video brief or an existing composition needing design direction
boundaries: Focuses on creative direction rather than runtime-specific animation code
Do not invent facts or claims for brand and product material
